watches.name: Neue
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished silver 36mm case and sand white dial, offered on a clay suede strap or silver jubilee bracelet. Black baton hands with a tan needle. The clarity of modernism, softened – restrained in line, exact in detail, newly seen.

watches.name: Foundry
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished silver 41mm case with an off white dial, offered on clay or black suede strap. Luminous baton hands with a marine blue needle second hand. Warm materials and industrial permanence, reimagined.

watches.name: Essence
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished rose gold 36mm case and brown leather strap with a white dial. Rose gold baton hands and needle. The softer register of the collection – built to sit closest to the skin.

watches.name: Edition
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished silver 36 mm case and black suede strap with a white dial. Silver baton hands and needle. A piece that stays out of the way – chosen by the ones who already know what they're saying.

watches.name: Umbra
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished silver 36mm case and silver jubilee bracelet with a dark grey dial. Silver baton hands and needle. Named for the blackout at the centre of a shadow – the quiet rebellion of a dial for those who read the hour on their own terms.

watches.name: Lineage
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished silver 36mm case with a gold bezel and mixed metal jubilee bracelet, set against a crisp white dial. Gold baton hands and needle. Two metals meeting on the wrist – heirloom weight with a modern hand, built for the long line forward.

watches.name: Forma
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished gold 41mm case and deep blue suede strap with a white dial. Luminous gold baton hands and needle. Named for the form itself – proportion, line, and contrast, with nothing held back from the design.

watches.name: Meridian
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished gold 41mm case and camel suede strap with a deep teal sunburst dial. Gold feuille hands and needle. Colour story of the explorer – worn by the vagabond who measures distance in days, life in adventures.

watches.name: Sera
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished silver 41mm case and blue suede strap with a smoked blue sunburst dial. Silver feuille hands and needle. The evening hour drawn onto the dial – a shade that asks the day to slow, Homage in full colour.

watches.name: Monument
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished silver 41mm case and smooth black leather strap with a sunburst champagne dial. Feuille hands and a marine blue needle. Warmth caught in the cool frame of silver – a study in tension, held in balance.

watches.name: Legacy
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished gold 41mm case and brown suede strap with an eggshell white dial. Gold feuille hands and needle. Warmth held with intention – a piece that softens with years of wear, kept to be handed down.

watches.name: Opus
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished gold 36mm case and black suede strap with a mother-of-pearl dial. Gold feuille hands and needle. A dial that shifts with the light – iridescent, unrepeatable, a composition the wrist returns to.

watches.name: Reverie
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished gold 36mm case and jubilee bracelet with a white dial. Gold feuille hands and needle. A timepiece caught in daydream – made for the wrist that measures time without counting it.

watches.name: Heritage
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished silver 36mm case and jubilee bracelet with a silver sunburst dial. Feuille hands and a marine blue needle. A study in light – the dial shifting with every turn of the wrist, faithful to the old classics.

watches.name: Deco
watches.description: Polished silver case on a brushed steel bracelet, framing a forest green guilloché dial. A deep-toned study in geometric balance, paired exclusively with steel – a silhouette made to outlast the decade it enters.

watches.name: Sterling
watches.description: Polished silver case on a brushed steel bracelet or black Italian leather, framing an ivory guilloché dial. Revival in its most restrained form – worn by those who know understatement is its own style.

watches.name: Carmine
watches.description: Polished yellow gold case on a yellow gold bracelet or lizard-grain Italian leather, framed around a burgundy guilloché dial. A bold, tonal expression that redefines the essence of a dress-watch classic.

watches.name: Encore
watches.description: Polished yellow gold tank case on a brushed yellow gold bracelet or black crocodile Italian leather, framing an ivory guilloché dial. A song of a beloved classic design, elevated – a piece that brings a new outlook to an enduring favorite form.

watches.name: Racer
watches.description: Swiss made. Polished silver 41mm case and smooth black leather strap with a black dial. Luminous baton hands and a red needle. Designed in the spirit of the mid-century roadster – the language of speed, proudly worn.
